description: This is a Swift source file for the NodeAppModel class, part of an iOS application that manages device capabilities, network sessions, and integration with various services including camera, notifications, location, and gateway communication. It handles user interactions, system events, and communication with backend services through request/response patterns. The file defines the core logic for managing app state, network sessions, and device features, with integration points for system services and custom protocols.

classes.name: NotificationCallError
classes.description: Error type used for wrapping errors during notification call operations without pulling non-Sendable types.

classes.name: GatewayRelayIdentityResponse
classes.description: Decodable structure representing the response containing device ID and public key from a gateway relay.

classes.name: NotificationInvokeLatch
classes.description: A lockable and awaitable synchronization primitive for handling notification call responses.

classes.name: IOSDeepLinkAgentPolicy
classes.description: Enum containing static constants to control deep link message size limits.

classes.name: NodeAppModel
classes.description: Main class managing app state, network communications, device capabilities, and user interactions for the iOS app.

methods.name: setScenePhase
methods.description: Adjusts app behavior based on scene phase changes (active, background, inactive).

methods.name: beginBackgroundConnectionGracePeriod
methods.description: Starts a background task to keep the connection alive during backgrounded state with a grace period.

methods.name: endBackgroundConnectionGracePeriod
methods.description: Ends the background connection grace period background task.

methods.name: grantBackgroundReconnectLease
methods.description: Provides a time lease to allow re-establishing network connections in background.

methods.name: suppressBackgroundReconnect
methods.description: Temporarily suppresses background reconnection attempts and optionally disconnects the sessions.

methods.name: clearBackgroundReconnectSuppression
methods.description: Removes suppression of background reconnections.

methods.name: setVoiceWakeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice wake functionality.

methods.name: setTalkEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the 'talk' mode, updating settings and notifying the gateway.

methods.name: requestLocationPermissions
methods.description: Requests user location permission based on the specified mode.

methods.name: seamColor
methods.description: Returns the current UI seam color derived from a stored hex string.

methods.name: refreshBrandingFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches branding configuration from the gateway and updates UI parameters.

methods.name: refreshAgentsFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches the list of available agents and updates internal state.

methods.name: refreshGatewayOverviewIfConnected
methods.description: Updates branding and agent list if the gateway is connected.

methods.name: setSelectedAgentId
methods.description: Selects an agent ID, updates related settings, and persists the selection.

methods.name: setGlobalWakeWords
methods.description: Updates the global voice wake words/trigger words via the gateway.

methods.name: startVoiceWakeSync
methods.description: Starts listening for voice wake word changes and gateway events related to voice wake mode.

methods.name: applyTalkModeSync
methods.description: Synchronizes the talk mode state from the gateway to local state.

methods.name: pushTalkModeToGateway
methods.description: Sends current talk mode state to the gateway.

methods.name: startGatewayHealthMonitor
methods.description: Begins periodic health checks to ensure gateway connectivity.

methods.name: stopGatewayHealthMonitor
methods.description: Stops periodic gateway health checks.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Main handler for incoming commands, dispatches to specific handlers.

methods.name: isBackgroundRestricted
methods.description: Checks if a command can be executed in background mode.

methods.name: handleLocationInvoke
methods.description: Handles location-related commands, such as fetching current location.

methods.name: handleCanvasInvoke
methods.description: Handles canvas-related commands like navigation, snapshots, and JavaScript evaluation.

methods.name: handleCanvasA2UIInvoke
methods.description: Handles commands related to the A2UI canvas, such as reset or message push.

methods.name: handleCameraInvoke
methods.description: Handles camera commands like listing devices, taking snapshots, and recording clips.

methods.name: handleScreenRecordInvoke
methods.description: Handles screen recording commands.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify
methods.description: Triggers a local system notification with specified title and body.

methods.name: handleChatPushInvoke
methods.description: Pushes chat messages as notifications and optionally speaks the message.

methods.name: requestNotificationAuthorizationIfNeeded
methods.description: Requests notification permission if not already granted.

methods.name: notificationAuthorizationStatus
methods.description: Checks current notification authorization status.

methods.name: runNotificationCall
methods.description: Runs a notification-related async operation with timeout and synchronization.

methods.name: refreshAgentsFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches the list of available agents from the gateway and updates internal state.
